entries.viewport: 640x400 CSS px @ deviceScaleFactor 4 (CDP Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride) — the genuine layout-viewport equivalent of a 1280x800 physical window at real browser 200% zoom
entries.backend_mode: REAL PPG-DaLiA S14 replay, real isolated repository backend
entries.purpose: F-07 required: 200% zoom accessibility evidence. STAGE4-5 CORRECTION: the prior evidence used document.documentElement.style.zoom=2 (a CSS property mutation), which this mission's rules explicitly disallow as 'real browser zoom' because it does not shrink window.innerWidth/clientWidth the way genuine zoom does, masking overflow bugs that only manifest when the layout viewport itself shrinks. The original file is preserved unmodified for the audit trail at docs/claude-stage4-5-visual-command-deck/superseded-stage2-3-evidence/mission-overview-zoom-INCORRECT-used-css-zoom-property.png. This replacement uses CDP device-metrics override to genuinely halve the CSS layout viewport (1280x800 -> 640x400) at doubled pixel density, which is the standard, accepted DevTools-protocol mechanism for emulating browser zoom and is confirmed to change window.innerWidth (1280->640) unlike the CSS property.
entries.visual_review: pass — no horizontal overflow (document.documentElement.scrollWidth === clientWidth === 640), app correctly falls back to its mobile navigation bar at this effective width, all critical status (session/source/connection/replay-state/fault) remains visible without scrolling
